name: codebuddy-provider
description: Register CodeBuddy models as a VS Code language model provider, usable inside Copilot Chat / Agent.

codebuddy.accessToken.markdownDescription: CodeBuddy access token (from the CodeBuddy console/backend or the official plugin/CLI login). Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. When empty, the `CODEBUDDY_AUTH_TOKEN` environment variable is used.

codebuddy.userId.markdownDescription: CodeBuddy account uid, sent as `X-User-Id`. When empty, the request falls back to `X-No-User-Id: 1`.

codebuddy.modelsCacheTtlSeconds.markdownDescription: How long (in seconds) to keep the fetched model list before refreshing it automatically. Minimum 30. Use the `CodeBuddy: Refresh Models` command to refresh immediately.

codebuddy.enterpriseId.markdownDescription: CodeBuddy enterprise id. When set, the model list is fetched from `/console/enterprises/{enterpriseId}/config/models`; when empty, it falls back to `/console/enterprises/personal/models`.

codebuddy.enableReasoning.markdownDescription: When enabled (default), `reasoning_content` from the model (e.g. DeepSeek thinking) is surfaced as a `LanguageModelThinkingPart`. When disabled, reasoning chunks are ignored to avoid inflating context history and token consumption.
